signal: CAI Software completed a merger of equals with Print ePS, forming three divisions and launching ShopVue Cloud MES, with a new enterprise AI strategy

email.subject1: a signal play for CAI Software
email.body1:
Rachael, saw CAI Software merged with Print ePS into three divisions and launched ShopVue Cloud, with a new enterprise AI push underway.

A merger and new product usually mean more in-market accounts than the worldwide sales team can cover, and that is where good-fit deals quietly stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for CAI Software off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Rachael, quick follow-up for CAI Software.

Post-merger, the addressable market across three divisions grows faster than your selling capacity can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to cover the combined base, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings CAI needs across process, discrete, and graphics this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Rachael, last bit of proof for CAI Software.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how CAI's reply rate likely compares to other manufacturing software firms post-merger. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Rachael, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling worldwide pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating a merger across three divisions is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a multi-division manufacturing software motion? I will tailor it to CAI either way.
